tools.description: Find directories under the user's home whose name contains the query. Names that look like secrets are left out and the result says so.
tools.name: find_dir

tools.description: List the entries of a directory under the user's home. Names that look like secrets are left out and the result says so.
tools.name: list_dir

tools.description: Read a text file under the user's home.
tools.name: read_file

tools.description: Type a shell command into the user's pane. The result says whether it was only typed or typed and run, and carries the output of a command that ran, which may be "not available". A single cd, pwd, ls, tree or mkdir with plain or quoted paths (no &&, ;, |, $ or redirections) can run directly when the user allows it; anything else waits for the user to approve it and press Enter. Prefer one simple command per call. You cannot change files yourself. Only mkdir can run directly; any other change needs a command the user reviews and runs.
tools.name: run_in_pane
